verdict.rationale: Sardine's own marketing describes in-product AI agents that automate KYC/AML alert reviews, speed up investigations, perform supporting research on sanctions matches, and route higher-risk cases to analysts within its case management workspace. These are brief marketing claims, though. They do not explicitly cover transaction-monitoring alerts or the agent writing review notes; "audit-ready" only implies documentation. missing for 10: explicit evidence the agent investigates transaction-monitoring alerts, documented generation of review notes or case narratives, in-depth first-party docs on the agent workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: Agentic AML Ops: Automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations with audit-ready agents.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
